response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kavg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kavg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
